name: cTSUserToolBase::vf22

Hook entry added, not run in-game. No mutant was aimed at this function; its target slot is checked by the recorder (the calls must match).

name: cTSUserToolBase::vf23
notes: Slot 23, 15 bytes, ret 4. Tail-jumps to the delegate's slot 17 with the same argument. With no delegate the original returns with eax untouched (undefined): the test does not compare the result there, only the state and the calls. 4000 cases. Hook entry added, not run in-game. Mutant killed: slot 17 -> 16.

name: cTSUserToolBase::vf29
notes: Slot 29, 22 bytes, ret 0x14. Tail-jumps to the delegate's slot 23 with five arguments; returns 0 without a delegate. 4000 cases with random arguments. Hook entry added, not run in-game. Mutant killed: fifth argument replaced by the fourth.

name: cTSUserToolBase::vf30
notes: Slot 30, 17 bytes, ret 0xc. Tail-jumps to the delegate's slot 24 with three arguments; returns 0 without a delegate. 4000 cases. Hook entry added, not run in-game. Mutant killed: second and third arguments swapped.

name: cTSUserToolBase::vf31
notes: Slot 31, 45 bytes, ret 0x10. Calls the delegate's slot 25 as (a1, a2, a3, 1, a4) and returns al = (low byte of the result != 0), 0 without a delegate. The original leaves the other bits of eax alone, so only al is compared. 4000 cases with results 0, 1, 0x100, 0xff and random. Hook entry added, not run in-game. Mutants killed: the constant 1 replaced by 0, the bool replaced by the full eax compare.

name: cTSUserToolBase::vf32
notes: Slot 32, 45 bytes, ret 0x10. Calls the delegate's slot 26 as (a1, a2, a3, a4, 1) and returns al = (low byte of the result != 0), 0 without a delegate. Only al is compared. 4000 cases. Hook entry added, not run in-game. Mutant killed: constant 1 moved before a4.

name: cTSUserToolBase::vf9
notes: Slot 9, 20 bytes, ret 0x10. Calls this's own slot 18 with (a1, a2, a3) and returns its eax; the fourth argument is ignored. The own vtable is routed to a recorder for the test. 4000 cases. Hook entry added, not run in-game. Mutant killed: second and third arguments swapped.

name: cTSUserToolBase::vf8
notes: Slot 8, 32 bytes, ret 0x10. Copies the two dwords at a3 to +0x14 and +0x18, then calls this's own slot 17 with (a1, a2, a3 pointer) and returns its eax; the fourth argument is ignored. The third argument is a pointer to scratch bytes, recorded relative to the side. 4000 cases. Hook entry added, not run in-game. Mutant killed: +0x18 receives the first dword instead of the second.

name: cTSUserToolBuyBuild::vf44
notes: Slot 44 of BuyBuild, 7 bytes, ret 4. Clears the byte at +0x4c; the argument is ignored. 4000 cases. Hook entry added, not run in-game. Also called directly by GroundBased vf44 (0x78ec49), which is why the reimplementation's ClearByte4CAndNotify calls it directly. No mutant was aimed at this function.

name: cTSUserToolGroundBased::vf38

name: cTSUserToolGroundBased::vf44

name: cTSUserToolGroundBased::vf60
notes: Slot 60, 5 bytes, ret 0. Clears the byte at +0x50. Shared by 19 classes through the vtable. 4000 cases. Hook entry added, not run in-game. No mutant was aimed at this function.

name: cTSUserToolBuyBuild::vf4
notes: Not reimplemented. Skipped: the body is long (an EH frame with six states, a string-like local at ebp-0x3c..-0x30, about a dozen virtual calls on objects returned by 0x20ddfb and 0x212e61, and the calls to 0x1bec0e and 0x1bf753 on a temporary). Its callees are all verified or library per candidates.py, so it is ready in principle; a faithful test needs fakes for each vtable slot it calls, which this batch did not have time to build.

name: cTSUserToolGroundBased::vf48
notes: Not reimplemented, not hooked. Body: mov eax,[ecx]; jmp [eax+0xf0], a tail call to this's own slot 60 (cTSUserToolGroundBased::vf60, reimplemented here as ClearFlag50), so it is a plain forwarder of no arguments. Left out of this batch to stay at fifteen functions.
